# Smart Packing Pro

> Smart Packing Pro is an offline-first AI travel packing app for Android. It generates day-by-day itineraries and context-aware packing lists with Trip Genius AI (400+ destinations as of 2026), and stores passports and documents in an AES-256 encrypted Travel Vault. Free to start, no account required, works 100% offline.

## Key facts

- Platform: Android 7.0 and up (Google Play)
- Price: Free to start (5 lifetime trips); Pro Lifetime is a one-time fee with a 7-day free trial — no subscription
- Privacy: Offline-first. Weather and destination lookup send the city name, destination coordinates and IP address to GeoNames and MET Norway. No account. Optional analytics/crash reports are off until you opt in.
- Security: AES-256 encrypted Travel Vault, biometric document lock, encrypted backup & restore
- AI: Trip Genius generates itineraries + packing lists across 400+ cities/countries, growing automatically (no app update needed)
- Sharing: Offline peer-to-peer trip sharing via QR code, SPP-TRIP code, or phone-to-phone

## Install

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.androidapp.smartpackingpro

## Common questions answered on the site

- Does it work offline? Yes for packing; weather and destination lookup need internet and share the city name, coordinates and IP address with GeoNames and MET Norway.
- Is it free? Yes — 5 lifetime trips free, plus a 7-day Pro trial; Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
- Is my data secure? Trips stay on your phone, no account is required, optional diagnostics are opt-in, and Travel Vault uses AES-256 encryption.
- What is Trip Genius AI? An AI planner covering 400+ destinations that builds itineraries and packing lists.
